title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Performance Analysis of a Scanner-Integrated Artificial Intelligence Model for the Detection of Intracranial Hemorrhages in a Traumatology Emergency Department.
summary: Retrospective evaluation of a scanner-integrated AI model for intracranial hemorrhage on 435 consecutive CT scans with radiologist reference, giving a clinically specific diagnostic accuracy assessment.
ai_technology: A scanner-integrated AI model analyzes CT images to detect intracranial hemorrhage, with radiologist readings as reference.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Retrospective evaluation included 435 consecutive CT scans and measured diagnostic accuracy against radiologist assessment.
evidence.unknown: The study is a retrospective, single-department accuracy assessment; external performance and patient outcomes are unknown.
evidence.ai_role: A scanner-integrated AI model analyzes CT images to detect intracranial hemorrhage, with radiologist readings as reference.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
